trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: Scientists have determined what the plant dies if it gets too hot.
trap.right: Scientists have determined that the plant dies if it gets too hot.
trap.why: Em português “determinaram que”, e o brasileiro usa what. Além disso: condicional zero (if + presente, presente) para fatos científicos.

mcq.q: Scientists have determined **___** the plant needs water.
If the plant **___** too hot, it dies.

opts: Because of the heat, it died.
By the heat of, it died.

fix.right: Because of the drought, crops failed.

fix.wrong: If it will get hot, the plant dies.
fix.right: If it gets hot, the plant dies.

rewrite.prompt: Complete: “… of the drought, the crops failed.”
rewrite.answer: Because of the drought, the crops failed.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “It gets hot. The plant dies.” (If…)
rewrite.answer: If it gets hot, the plant dies.
